import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { invoice } from "./invoice";
import { track } from "./track";

export const invoiceLine = defineTable("invoice_line", {
    columns: {
        invoiceLineId: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        invoiceId: col.integer().notNull(),
        trackId: col.integer().notNull(),
        unitPrice: col.numeric(10, 2).notNull(),
        quantity: col.integer().notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        invoice: rel.belongsTo(() => invoice, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        track: rel.belongsTo(() => track, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
